messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

function.name: investment_analysis_calculate_profit

message.content:
營收（Revenue） = 15,000 USD  
總成本（Cost） = 22,000 USD  

**1. 計算淨利潤 (Net Profit)**  
淨利潤 = 營收 – 總成本  
= 15,000 USD – 22,000 USD  
= **‑7,000 USD**  

**2. 計算回報率 (Return Rate)**  
常見的「回報率」指的是「淨利潤佔營收的比例」，即 **淨利潤率 (Net Profit Margin)**。  
回報率 = (淨利潤 ÷ 營收) × 100%  
= (‑7,000 ÷ 15,000) × 100%  
≈ **‑46.7 %**  

> **解釋**  
> - 負值表示該企業在此期間虧損，虧損幅度相當於營收的 46.7%。  
> - 若你想知道「投資回報率 (ROI)」則可用淨利潤除以總成本：  
>   ROI = (‑7,000 ÷ 22,000) × 100% ≈ **‑31.8 %**。  

所以，根據常見定義，這家企業的回報率約為 **‑46.7 %**。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？" They want the return rate. Return rate likely means net profit / total revenue? Or net profit margin? They gave revenue and cost. Net profit = revenue - cost = -7000. Return rate maybe net profit / revenue = -7000/15000 = -0.4667 or -46.67%. Alternatively return on investment (ROI) = net profit / cost? That would be -7000/22000 = -0.318 = -31.8%. But typical return rate is net profit margin: net profit / revenue. So answer: -46.7%.
